pieces.purpose: the logo as a window — a soft light drifts through the mark
pieces.title: bonk — glow
pieces.notes: Holds rather than builds — there is no reveal, no resolve, no cut. The sweep is the whole piece. The gradient falls to roughly zero at both frame edges, so the loop wraps with no visible seam.
